start.welcome:
👋 Welcome to HMQA JURNAL BOT.

This bot allows you to submit research articles to HMQA Academy journals electronically, review journal and publication requirements, respond to editorial requests, and track the review status of your submissions.

📌 Main features:
📚 Journals and publication requirements
📝 Submit a new article
📂 Track submitted articles
🔄 Submit a revised version
🔔 Receive editorial notifications
👤 Manage your author profile

Choose an option below 👇
consent.short: To submit an article, the bot processes your contact and professional details and documents for receipt, registration, and review.

help.submit.text: Open “Submit article”, choose a journal, read its requirements, enter the requested details and upload every required file. Your work remains a draft until final confirmation.
help.files.text: Allowed formats and size limits are shown for the selected journal. Every file is validated and scanned for malware.
help.statuses.text: “Submitted” means the system received the article; it does not mean publication acceptance. Editorial decisions appear separately as “Accepted” or “Rejected”.
help.revision.text: Open “My submissions”, choose a submission requiring changes, then select “Submit new version”. Earlier versions remain preserved.
